DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。化粧品選びで気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there anything concerning you as you choose cosmetics?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 顔に使うものを探しています。前に別の商品で赤くなったので、帯広のこの売場で試してから選べるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前ほかの顔用製品で赤くなったことを伝え、新しい商品を売場で試してから選べるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for something to use on my face. Another product made my skin red before, so I want to know whether I can try a product at this shop in Obihiro before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say another facial product previously caused redness and ask whether you can try a new product in the shop before choosing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の商品の名前や成分はわかりますか。今も赤みなど、気になる症状がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the previous product's name or ingredients? Do you still have redness or any other symptoms you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 商品名は写真にあります。今も頬が赤いんですが、低刺激と書いてあるものなら試せると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 以前の商品名は写真でわかり、今も頬が赤いが、低刺激という表示があれば試せると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The product name is in a photo. My cheeks are still red, but I thought I could try something labeled low-irritation.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the previous product's name is in a photo and your cheeks are still red, but you thought you could try a product labeled low-irritation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 低刺激という表示でも、ご自身に合うとは保証できません。症状がある所へ試す前に、医療機関などへ相談してください。今日は表示の確認にとどめますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: A low-irritation label does not guarantee that a product will suit you. Before trying anything on an area with symptoms, consult a medical provider or similar professional. Would you like to limit today to checking labels?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、顔には試しません。前の商品と候補の成分表示を比べたいですが、同じ成分があればそれが原因と考えていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は顔に試さないと伝え、以前の商品と候補に同じ成分があれば赤みの原因だと判断してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will not try it on my face. I want to compare the ingredient labels of the previous product and the candidate, but if they share an ingredient, can I assume it caused the redness?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not try anything on your face today, and ask whether an ingredient shared by the previous and candidate products can be judged the cause of redness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示の比較だけで原因を特定することはできません。気になる表示を控えて、症状と使った時期を専門家へ伝える材料にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Comparing labels alone cannot identify the cause. Note any ingredients of concern and use that information to tell a professional about your symptoms and when you used the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。原因は決めつけず、写真と使った時期を整理します。候補の商品情報を控えて持ち帰ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原因を決めつけず写真と使用時期を整理するので、候補の商品情報も控えて持ち帰ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not assume the cause; I will organize the photo and dates of use. May I also note the candidate product's information to take home?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will organize the photo and usage dates without assuming a cause, and ask to note the candidate product's information to take home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご自身が確認する商品の表示を控えてください。試用品は今日は使わず、相談結果を踏まえてから選ぶこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please note the labels of the products you are checking. You can leave the testers unused today and make your choice after taking the consultation results into account.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は購入と試用を見送ります。前の商品と症状の経緯、候補の表示をまとめて相談し、使うかどうかはその後に考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入と試用を今日は見送り、以前の商品、症状の経緯、候補の表示をまとめて専門家に相談してから使用を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put off both buying and trying anything today. I will gather the previous product, the history of symptoms, and the candidate's label for a consultation, and consider whether to use it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will postpone buying and trying products today and gather the previous product, symptom history, and candidate label to consult a professional before considering use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な表示の確認をお手伝いします。気になる症状を先にご相談ください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will help you check the necessary labels. Please consult about your symptoms first. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。気になる中古家電はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there any used appliance you are interested in?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帯広の部屋で使う洗濯機を探しています。この幅なら置けそうですが、動作を確認してから買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋で使う中古洗濯機を探しており、幅は置けそうなので動作を確認してから購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for a washing machine for my room in Obihiro. This width seems to fit, but I want to check that it works before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are looking for a used washing machine for your room, its width seems suitable, and you want to check its operation before purchasing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認できる動作と状態の案内を見ましょう。設置場所だけでなく、玄関や途中の通路を通れる寸法も測っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the information on its condition and what functions can be checked. Have you measured not only the installation space but also the doorway and passageways along the delivery route?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 置く場所の幅しか測っていません。階段と玄関の曲がる所が狭いので、運べない可能性があるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 設置場所の幅しか測っておらず、階段と玄関の曲がり角が狭いため搬入できない可能性があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only measured the width where it will go. The stairs and the turn at the entrance are narrow, so it might not be possible to bring it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only measured the installation width and the narrow stairs and turn at the entrance may prevent delivery inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 搬入できるかを先に確かめましょう。配送や設置に対応できるか、その条件も確認します。給水と排水の接続場所は見ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us confirm first whether it can be brought in. We will also check whether delivery and installation are available and their conditions. Have you looked at the water supply and drain connection points?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 排水口は見ましたが、使うホースや蛇口への接続はわかりません。付属品が足りなくても、自分で別のものを付ければよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 排水口は見たがホースや蛇口との接続はわからず、不足部品は自分で別のものを付ければよいと考えていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saw the drain, but I do not know which hose to use or how it connects to the tap. I thought that if accessories were missing, I could attach different ones myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw the drain but do not understand the hose or tap connections, and thought you could substitute other parts yourself if any were missing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 適合を確認せず部品を取り付けないでください。この商品の付属品と必要な接続を確認しましょう。設置先の写真があると相談しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not attach parts without checking compatibility. Let us check this product's accessories and required connections. Photos of the installation location will make it easier to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は写真がないので、寸法と接続場所を調べて出直します。その間に、保証と返品条件を読むための案内をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は設置先の写真がないので寸法と接続場所を調べて出直すと伝え、保証と返品条件の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not have photos today, so I will check the measurements and connection points and come back. Meanwhile, could you give me information so I can read the warranty and return conditions?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have no photos of the installation location today and will check measurements and connections before returning, and request warranty and return information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品の状態、保証や返品の条件、配送の案内を確認してお伝えします。取り置きできるかも別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check and explain the product's condition, warranty and return conditions, and delivery information. Whether we can reserve it also needs checking separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 購入はまだ決めません。通路の寸法と接続場所を確認し、付属品、動作、保証、配送費を含めて比べてから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入を保留し、搬入経路と接続場所を調べ、付属品、動作、保証、配送費も含めて比べてから相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not decide on the purchase yet. I will check the passageway measurements and connections, then compare the accessories, operation, warranty, and delivery costs before consulting you.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will hold off on purchasing, check the delivery route and connections, and compare accessories, operation, warranty, and delivery costs before consulting again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まずこの商品の状態と条件をご案内します。運べることまで確認してからお選びください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, I will explain this product's condition and terms. Please confirm that it can be brought in before choosing. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お薬の説明で、先に確認しておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you want to check before the medication explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帯広で受診して、この処方箋を受け取りました。私は夜勤なので、『朝』の薬をいつ飲むことになるか、説明を聞く前から気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受診後の処方箋を示し、夜勤をしているため朝に飲むという指示の時間が気になっていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a doctor in Obihiro and received this prescription. I work nights, so even before hearing the explanation, I am wondering when I should take the 'morning' medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your prescription after seeing the doctor and say you are concerned about the timing of the morning dose because you work nights. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 処方内容を確認して薬剤師が説明します。普段の起きる時間と、食事の時間を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pharmacist will check the prescription and explain. Could you tell us when you usually wake up and eat?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼ごろ起きて、夕方に食事をしてから出勤します。朝は仕事から帰って寝る前なので、起きた時を朝と考えていいのか迷います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼ごろ起き、夕方に食事をして出勤し、朝は帰宅して寝るので、起床時を朝と考えてよいか迷っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wake up around noon and eat in the evening before going to work. In the morning, I come home from work and go to bed, so I am unsure whether I can treat my waking time as morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you wake around noon, eat in the evening before work, and return home to sleep in the morning, so you are unsure whether waking time counts as morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 言葉だけで時間を置き換えず、今回の薬について確認しましょう。ほかに飲んでいる薬や、市販の製品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check this particular medicine rather than substituting times based on the wording alone. Are you taking any other medicines or over-the-counter products?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 市販の薬を一つ使っています。名前を覚えていないので、家にある箱の写真を確認して薬剤師に見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前を覚えていない市販薬も使っているので、家にある箱の写真を確認して薬剤師に見せたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I use one over-the-counter medicine. I do not remember its name, so I want to check a photo of its box at home and show it to the pharmacist.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you also use an over-the-counter medicine whose name you do not remember and want to check a photo of its box at home to show the pharmacist. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真で名称と成分を確認できるようにしてください。わからないまま組み合わせを決めず、確認できていないことも薬剤師へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please make sure the name and ingredients can be checked in the photo. Do not decide to combine them while unsure, and tell the pharmacist what has not yet been confirmed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勤務と食事の時刻を紙に書きます。今回の服用時間を説明してもらったら、自分の言葉で言い直して合っているか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務と食事の時刻を紙に書き、服用時間の説明を自分の言葉で言い直して理解が合っているか確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write my work and meal times on paper. After the dosage schedule is explained, I would like to repeat it in my own words to check that I have understood correctly.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will write down work and meal times and restate the dosage timing in your own words to check your understanding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。薬剤師に確認しながら説明を言い直してください。飲み忘れた時や勤務が変わった時の相談方法も、今回の薬に合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please restate the explanation while checking with the pharmacist. We will also check how to seek advice for this medicine if you miss a dose or your shifts change.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬の箱の写真と生活時間を見せ、薬剤師の説明を聞いてから時間を決めます。自分で朝を読み替えたり、飲む量を変えたりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬の箱の写真と生活時間を薬剤師に示して説明を聞き、自分で朝の意味を読み替えたり服用量を変えたりしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the medicine-box photo and my daily schedule, then determine the timing after hearing the pharmacist's explanation. I will not reinterpret morning or change the dose myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the pharmacist the medicine-box photo and daily schedule and listen to the explanation, without reinterpreting morning or changing dosage yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。薬剤師へ勤務時間とご質問をお伝えします。わからない点を残さず、一緒に確認しましょう。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the pharmacist your working hours and questions. Let us check everything together so nothing remains unclear. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。レンタル用品について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about rental equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帯広で友人のスキーを見学するつもりでしたが、私も体験したくなりました。道具を借りれば、初心者でも一緒に滑れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人のスキーを見学する予定から自分も体験する希望に変わったので、道具を借りれば初心者でも一緒に滑れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to watch my friend ski in Obihiro, but now I would like to try too. If I rent equipment, can a beginner ski with them?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your plan changed from watching your friend ski to trying it yourself, and ask whether a beginner can ski with them by renting equipment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用具のレンタルと、滑り方の指導や参加条件は別に確認が必要です。スキーの経験はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Equipment rental needs checking separately from instruction and participation requirements. Have you skied before?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まったくありません。友人は上手なので、同じ道具を借りれば同じ場所へ行けると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: スキー経験がなく、上手な友人と同じ道具を借りれば同じ場所へ行けると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Never. My friend is good at skiing, so I thought renting the same equipment would let me go to the same places.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no skiing experience and thought the same equipment would allow you to go to the same places as your skilled friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 経験に合う場所や指導の案内を、利用先の担当者に確認してください。用具も友人のものではなく、ご本人の体格やサイズに合わせて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask the staff at the facility about areas and instruction suited to your experience. We will also discuss equipment for your own build and size, rather than your friend's.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では先に初心者向けの案内を聞きます。ブーツのサイズを試して、痛い時は自分で留め具を緩めればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まず初心者向けの案内を聞くと伝え、試したブーツが痛い場合に自分で留め具を緩めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will ask about beginner guidance first. When trying boot sizes, if they hurt, may I loosen the fasteners myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will first ask about guidance for beginners, and ask whether you may loosen the fasteners yourself if the boots you try hurt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 痛みや合わなさは担当者へ伝えて調整を相談してください。板との接続などを自己判断で変えず、使い方の説明を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the staff about pain or poor fit and ask about adjustment. Do not alter connections to the skis or other settings on your own judgment; receive an explanation of how to use them.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分では調整しません。参加の案内が受けられなければ今日は見学に戻ります。申込み前にキャンセルと返却の条件も聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用具は自分で調整せず、参加の案内を受けられなければ見学に戻ると伝え、申込み前にキャンセルと返却条件を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not adjust them myself. If I cannot get guidance for participating, I will go back to watching today. May I also ask about cancellation and return conditions before applying?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not adjust equipment yourself and will return to watching if participation guidance is unavailable, and ask to check cancellation and return conditions before applying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。レンタルの申込みと返却条件をご説明します。体験や指導の申込み先が別なら、そちらの条件も確認してから決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I will explain the rental application and return conditions. If the experience or lessons have a separate booking contact, check their conditions too before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 初心者の参加条件と指導を先に確かめます。参加できる場合だけサイズと使い方を確認して借り、調整は担当者に頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 初心者の参加条件と指導を先に確認し、参加できる場合にサイズと使い方を確認して借り、調整は担当者に頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first check beginner participation requirements and instruction. Only if I can participate will I check the size and use of the equipment and rent it, and I will ask staff to adjust it.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will first check beginner participation requirements and instruction, check size and use before renting only if you can participate, and ask staff for adjustments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず確認先をご案内します。無理に友人と同じ場所へ行かず、ご自身に合う体験をお選びください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, I will show you whom to ask. Please choose an experience suited to you instead of pushing yourself to go to the same places as your friend. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。税務関係の書類について、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with tax-related documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先から受け取った給与の書類と、口座に入った金額の合計が違います。どの資料をそろえて確認すればよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与の書類と口座への入金合計が違うと伝え、確認に必要な資料を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The salary document I received from my employer differs from the total deposited in my account. I would like advice on which records to gather to check this.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the salary document and total bank deposits differ, and ask what records you need to check them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、書類の項目名と対象の期間を確認しましょう。口座の合計は、どの期間のどの入金を足したものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us check the document's item names and period covered. Which deposits over what period did you add up for the account total?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一月から十二月までの入金を足しました。でも七月に転職したので、この書類は今の会社の分だけです。前の会社の分も同じ合計に入れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一年分の口座入金に前の会社の分も含めたが、書類は転職後の会社分だけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I added the deposits from January through December. But I changed jobs in July, so this document only covers my current company. I included deposits from my previous company in the same total.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your full-year bank total includes the previous company, but the document only covers your employer after changing jobs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先ごと、対象期間ごとに分けて見ましょう。今の会社からの入金にも、給与以外の説明が付いているものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate them by employer and period. Do any deposits from your current company have descriptions other than salary?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出張で立て替えた代金の精算が、給与と同じ日に入っていました。入金した日だけで給与だと決めて足したので、明細の項目も確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出張の立替精算も給与と同じ日に入り、日付だけで給与として合計したと説明して明細を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Reimbursement for business-trip expenses I paid upfront was deposited on the same day as my salary. I added it as salary based only on the deposit date, so I want to check the item names on the statements too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that expense reimbursement for a business trip came on the salary date and you counted it as salary by date alone, and say you want to check the statements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 口座の入金日だけでは内容を区別できません。給与明細と立替精算の控えを対応させ、分からない項目は勤務先へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The deposit date alone does not distinguish what a payment is for. Match payslips with expense-reimbursement records and ask your employer about any unclear items.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 精算の控えが一枚見つかりません。数字が合うように適当な額を引くのではなく、その月の明細を会社に再確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 精算控えが一枚ないと伝え、金額を推測で引かず該当月の明細を会社に確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot find one reimbursement record. Instead of subtracting a guessed amount to make the figures match, I will ask my company to check that month's statement again.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say one reimbursement record is missing and you will ask the company about that month's statement rather than subtract a guessed amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように、不明な部分を推測で埋めずに整理してください。税務書類の訂正が必要かも、確認した内容をもとに担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, organize the information without filling unknown gaps by guessing. You can also consult the person in charge about whether tax documents need correcting based on the information you confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの勤務先と期間を分け、給与明細、口座の記録、精算の控えをそろえます。足りない控えと書類の項目を会社へ確認してから、訂正が必要か相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務先と期間を分けて明細と入金記録、精算控えを揃え、不足と項目を会社へ確認してから訂正の要否を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separate the two employers and periods and gather payslips, bank records, and reimbursement records. After checking the missing record and document items with my company, I will ask whether a correction is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate employers and periods, gather statements, deposit records, and reimbursement records, check missing information and items with the company, then ask whether correction is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できた数字と未確認の項目を分けたメモをお持ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OBIHIRO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring notes distinguishing confirmed figures from unconfirmed items. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。乗船前に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you want to check before boarding?

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で小樽の遊覧船に乗りたいです。ただ、友人はこのあと帰る予定があるので、降りる場所と戻る時刻を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で遊覧船に乗りたいが友人には帰る予定があるので、降りる場所と戻る時刻を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-02.translation: The two of us would like to take a sightseeing boat in Otaru. But my friend has plans to go home afterward, so we want to know where we disembark and when we return.
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say two of you want to take a sightseeing boat, but your friend has plans to go home, so you want to know the disembarkation point and return time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 候補の便の案内を確認しましょう。乗った所へ戻る便を希望されますか。それとも別の場所で降りる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the information for a possible sailing. Would you like one that returns to where you board, or do you plan to get off elsewhere?

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに戻るつもりです。案内の出発時刻を見て、その時刻には戻れると勘違いしていました。帰りの予定には余裕を取りたいです。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗った場所へ戻る希望を伝え、出発時刻を帰着時刻だと勘違いしていたので帰路の予定に余裕を取りたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-04.translation: We intend to return here. I saw the departure time and mistakenly thought we would be back by then. I want to leave plenty of time for our journey home.
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to return to the boarding point and mistook the departure time for the return time, so you want to leave extra time for going home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出発と帰着は分けて確認しましょう。運航状況によって予定が変わる場合もあります。お二人とも、多少の変更には対応できますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check departure and return separately. Plans may change depending on operating conditions too. Can both of you accommodate a slight change?

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は難しそうです。それに船の揺れも心配しています。座って待てる場所や途中で降りられるかを、本人が確認したいそうです。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人は予定変更への対応が難しく船の揺れも心配しているので、座れる場所や途中で降りられるか本人が確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-06.translation: That seems difficult for my friend. They are also worried about the boat rocking. They want to ask for themselves about places to sit and wait and whether it is possible to get off along the way.
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your friend has little flexibility for schedule changes and worries about rocking, so they want to ask personally about seating and getting off along the way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗船中に好きな所で降りられるとは限りません。座席の案内と、乗船後に具合が悪くなった時の連絡方法を、担当者に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-07.translation: You cannot necessarily get off wherever you like during the sailing. Let us ask the staff about seating and how to contact them if someone feels unwell after boarding.

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら、途中で帰れると思って乗るのはやめます。友人と一緒に説明を聞いて、帰る予定に合う場合だけ購入したいです。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中で帰れると思って乗ることは避け、友人と説明を聞いて帰る予定に合う場合だけ購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-08.translation: In that case, we will not board on the assumption that we can return partway through. I would like to hear the explanation with my friend and buy tickets only if it fits their plans to go home.
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid boarding on the assumption you can return midway, listen to the explanation with your friend, and buy only if it fits the plans for going home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。帰着の案内、予定変更時の扱い、乗船中の相談方法を確認してからお決めください。購入前の条件もご説明します。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please decide after checking return information, arrangements for schedule changes, and how to seek help on board. I will also explain the conditions before purchase.

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず二人で帰着と変更時の条件を聞きます。余裕が取れなければ今回は乗らず、別の日に時間を空けて来ることにします。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人で帰着と予定変更時の条件を聞き、余裕が取れなければ今回は乗らず別の日に時間を空けて来ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-10.translation: First, we will both ask about the return and conditions for changes. If we cannot allow enough time, we will not sail this time and will come another day with more time available.
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will both ask about return and schedule-change conditions, and if you cannot allow enough time, skip the boat this time and come another day with time set aside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。無理のない予定でお選びください。それでは候補の便の案内を確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-HKD-OTARU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please choose a manageable schedule. Now, let us check the information for a possible sailing. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。工芸体験では、どんなものを作ってみたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to make in the craft experience?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小樽での記念に、友人への小さな贈り物を作りたいです。今日の夕方には帰るので、そのまま持ち帰れる体験を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人への小さな贈り物を作りたいが夕方には帰るので、当日持ち帰れる工芸体験を探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to make a small gift for a friend as a souvenir of Otaru. I leave this evening, so I am looking for an activity where I can take the piece home immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to make a small gift for a friend but leave this evening, so you are looking for a craft experience with same-day collection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 完成後に乾燥や仕上げが必要な体験もあります。作業時間だけでなく、受け取れる時点を確認しましょう。素材の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some activities require drying or finishing after the work is complete. Let us check when you can receive it, not just how long the work takes. Do you have a material preference?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 素材にはこだわりません。展示されている作品が気に入ったので、同じものならすぐ作れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 素材の希望は特になく、気に入った展示作品と同じものならすぐに作れると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not have a material preference. I liked the piece on display and thought I could make the same thing straight away.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no particular material preference and thought you could quickly make the same piece as the display you liked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その見本は、仕上げが済んだ木製の飾りです。同じ体験では仕上げは翌日になり、今日の夕方には持ち帰れません。今日持ち帰る内容を選ぶか、この木製飾りを後日受け取るか、お選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That sample is a finished wooden ornament. For that activity, finishing is done the following day, so you cannot take it home this evening. You can choose an activity with same-day collection or receive this wooden ornament later.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後日になる場合、発送できるかと費用も知りたいです。自分で帰りに運ぶより安心なら、受取りを遅らせても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後日受取りの場合に発送できるかと費用を尋ね、自分で運ぶより安心なら受取りを遅らせてもよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I receive it later, I also want to know whether you can ship it and how much that costs. If it is safer than carrying it home myself, I do not mind receiving it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether later collection can include shipping and what it costs, and say a delay is fine if it is safer than carrying the piece yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この木製飾りは、翌日の仕上げ後にこちらで梱包して発送できます。体験は千八百円、発送は五百円で、合計二千三百円です。形と模様を選び、下書きまではご自身でできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can pack and ship this wooden ornament after finishing it tomorrow. The activity is 1,800 yen and shipping is 500 yen, for a total of 2,300 yen. You can choose the shape and pattern and do the preliminary drawing yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道具を使う説明を見てから決めたいです。危険な工程を自分でしなくても、形や模様を自分で選べる内容はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道具の説明を見てから決めたいと伝え、危険な工程を自分で行わず形や模様を選べる体験があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to see the explanation of the tools before deciding. Is there an activity where I can choose the shape and pattern without doing the dangerous steps myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to see the tool explanation before deciding, and ask whether you can choose shape and pattern without performing dangerous steps yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 形は丸か四角、模様は花か波から選べます。裁断と仕上げの乾燥、梱包は担当者が行います。お客様が裁断の道具を使う内容ではありません。どの組合せにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can choose a circle or square shape and a flower or wave pattern. Staff handle cutting, drying the finish, and packing. This activity does not involve customers using cutting tools. Which combination would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 丸い形に波の模様でお願いします。下書きまで自分で行い、裁断と仕上げは担当者に任せます。合計二千三百円を確認したので、翌日の仕上げ後に発送する内容で申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 丸い波模様を選び、自分は下書きまでで裁断と仕上げを担当者に任せ、合計二千三百円と翌日の仕上げ後発送を確認して申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: A round shape with a wave pattern, please. I will do the preliminary drawing and leave cutting and finishing to the staff. I have confirmed the total of 2,300 yen, so I would like to sign up for shipping after tomorrow's finishing.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a round shape and wave pattern, say you will only do the preliminary drawing and leave cutting and finishing to staff, and apply after confirming the 2,300 yen total and shipping after tomorrow's finishing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。丸い形と波の模様、翌日の仕上げ後の発送ですね。送り先と申込み内容を確認してから、下書きの説明を始めます。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. A round shape with a wave pattern, shipped after finishing tomorrow. We will confirm the destination and application details before explaining the preliminary drawing. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。おみやげは、どなたへお渡しになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Who are you planning to give the souvenirs to?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場の同僚に、小樽のお菓子を少しずつ配りたいです。この二つの箱は、中の数が同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場の同僚に菓子を少しずつ配りたいので、候補の二箱に入っている個数が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to hand out small portions of Otaru sweets to my coworkers. Do these two boxes contain the same number of pieces?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to share sweets in small portions with coworkers and ask whether the two possible boxes contain the same number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の個数を比べましょう。配る時は、箱を開けて一つずつお渡しになるご予定ですか。個包装かも確認が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the quantities on the labels. Do you plan to open the box and give out pieces individually? We also need to check whether they are individually wrapped.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。中にたくさん入っていれば配れると思っていましたが、一つの袋に全部入っているものだと困ります。個包装を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱を開けて一つずつ渡す予定だが、一袋に全部入っていると配りにくいので個包装を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought I could share them if there were many inside, but it would be a problem if they were all in one bag. I want to choose individually wrapped sweets.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you plan to open the box and give out individual pieces, but one bag containing everything would be awkward, so you want individual wrapping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個数と包装の単位は別ですね。商品の表示で確認します。皆さんには同じ日にお渡しできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Piece count and packaging units are separate matters. We will check the product labels. Can you give them to everyone on the same day?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夜勤の同僚には後日渡します。すぐ食べてもらえるかわからないので、日持ちと保存方法も比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夜勤の同僚には後日渡し、すぐに食べるかわからないので、日持ちと保存方法も比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will give them to my night-shift coworkers later. I do not know whether they will eat them immediately, so I also want to compare shelf life and storage methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will give sweets to night-shift coworkers later and want to compare shelf life and storage because they may not eat them straight away. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、具体的な商品の期限と保存表示を見ましょう。箱を開けた後の扱いも確認し、外箱の期限だけを見て判断しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us check the actual products' dates and storage labels. We will also check handling after opening the box, rather than judging by the outer box's date alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 個包装に期限が書いていなければ、外箱の表示を控えて一緒に伝えたいです。包装を開けずに一つずつ配れるかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個包装に期限がなければ外箱の表示を控えて伝えたいと説明し、包装を開けずに一つずつ配れるか確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the individual wrappers have no date, I would like to note the outer box's label and pass that information along. Please also check whether I can hand out individual pieces without opening their wrappers.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to note and pass on the outer box's label if the individual wrappers have no date, and ask to check whether pieces can be distributed without opening their wrapping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。個包装の表示と、配る時に伝えたい保存情報を確認します。配る人数に対して、必要な箱数も見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will check the individual labels and storage information to pass along. Let us also check how many boxes you need for the number of recipients.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 個包装で、後日渡す人にも保存情報を伝えられるものを選びます。人数と個数を照合してから箱数を決め、期限の表示を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 後日渡す人にも保存情報を伝えられる個包装の商品を選び、人数と個数を照合して箱数を決め、期限表示を控えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose individually wrapped items whose storage information I can also give to people receiving them later. I will compare the number of people with the piece count before deciding how many boxes, and note the date label.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will choose individually wrapped products with storage information you can pass to later recipients, compare people and pieces to decide box quantities, and note the date label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。まず二つの商品の包装と期限を比べましょう。職場で配りやすいものをお選びいただけるよう、お手伝いします。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. First, let us compare the two products' packaging and dates. We will help you choose something easy to share at work. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。科学館の展示で、どんなことを知りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to learn about the science museum exhibits?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明を読むだけでなく、動きを見て理解できる展示を探しています。小樽の科学館で、自分で操作できるものがあるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 文章だけでなく動きを見て理解したいので、自分で操作できる科学館の展示があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for an exhibit I can understand by watching movement, rather than just reading explanations. I want to know whether there is anything I can operate myself at the science museum in Otaru.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to understand by watching movement as well as reading, and ask whether the science museum has exhibits you can operate yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 操作できる展示かは、それぞれの案内を確認しましょう。気になった装置はどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check each exhibit's instructions to see whether visitors can operate it. Which device caught your attention?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。ボタンに見える部分があったので触ろうとしましたが、触ってよいという表示が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 気になった歯車装置のボタンのような部分を触ろうとしたが、操作可能の表示が見当たらなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one. I was about to touch a part that looked like a button, but I cannot find a sign saying I may touch it.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you were about to touch a button-like part on the gear device you noticed but could not find a sign permitting operation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは係員が動かす実演用です。お客様が操作するボタンではありません。大きい歯車と小さい歯車の動きの違いを、ご覧になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is for staff-operated demonstrations. That is not a button for visitors to operate. Would you like to see how the large and small gears move differently?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 動かした時に、この二つの部分がどう変わるか見たいです。説明が長いので、見る順番を短く言い直してもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 装置を動かした時の二つの部分の変化を見たいので、長い説明を観察する順番に沿って短く言い直してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to see how these two parts change when it moves. The explanation is long, so it would help if you could restate it briefly in the order I should watch.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the long explanation to be restated briefly in observation order, because you want to see how two parts change when the device moves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず大きい歯車が一回まわるところを見て、その間に小さい歯車が何回まわるかを数えてください。次に、二つが同じ向きか反対向きかを見ます。私が操作しますので、この見学線の外でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, watch the large gear make one rotation and count how many times the small gear turns during that time. Next, see whether they turn in the same or opposite directions. I will operate it, so please watch from outside this viewing line.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で操作できなくても、担当者の実演を見られれば構いません。聞いた順番をメモして、合っているか確かめてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で操作できなくても担当者の実演を見られればよいと伝え、観察の順番をメモして理解が合っているか確かめてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is fine if I cannot operate it myself as long as I can watch the staff demonstration. May I note the order you explained and check whether I understood correctly?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say watching the staff demonstration is fine even without operating it yourself, and ask to note the observation order and check your understanding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、今ご説明した順番です。実演すると、大きい歯車が一回まわる間に、小さい歯車は二回まわり、向きは反対になります。ご自身のメモと比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, use the order I just explained. In the demonstration, the small gear turns twice while the large gear turns once, and they turn in opposite directions. Please compare that with your notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に大きい歯車一回を見て、その間の小さい歯車の回数、最後に向きを確認します。小さい方は二回で反対向きですね。装置には触れず見学線の外で見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大きい歯車一回の間に小さい方の回数を数え、最後に向きを見て、小さい方は二回で反対向きだと確認し、見学線の外で触れず見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: First, I will watch one rotation of the large gear, then count the small gear's rotations during that time, and finally check the direction. The small one turns twice in the opposite direction, correct? I will watch from outside the viewing line without touching the device.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will count the small gear's turns during one large-gear rotation and check direction last, confirm the small one turns twice in the opposite direction, and watch outside the line without touching. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その観察順で合っています。回数と向きを分けて確認できましたね。見学線の外から、もう一度ご覧ください。ご質問ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: That observation order is correct. You have checked the number of turns and direction separately. Please watch once more from outside the viewing line. Thank you for your questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。利用前に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you want to check before using the attraction?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この列に並んでいますが、リュックを持ったまま乗れるか気になりました。小樽に泊まる荷物も入っていて、足元に置くには大きいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: アトラクションの列に並んでいるが、宿泊の荷物を入れた大きなリュックを持ったまま乗れるか気になっていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am waiting in this line, but I am wondering whether I can ride with my backpack. It contains my luggage for staying in Otaru too, so it is too big to put at my feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are in line for an attraction but are concerned whether you can ride with a large backpack containing your overnight luggage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この設備の荷物の扱いを確認します。リュックを預ける場所や方法は、もう案内を受けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check how luggage is handled at this attraction. Have you already been told where or how to leave your backpack?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。近くにいる友人へ渡すために列を離れて、同じ場所に戻ればいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物の案内はまだ受けておらず、友人に渡すために列を離れても元の場所へ戻れると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought I could leave the line to give it to my friend nearby and then return to the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not received luggage guidance and thought you could return to your original place after leaving the line to give it to a friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列を離れた後に元の位置へ戻れるとは限りません。荷物の扱いと再合流の案内を、担当の係員へ先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You cannot necessarily return to your original position after leaving the line. Please ask the staff in charge first about luggage and rejoining.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、黙って列を離れないようにします。戻れない場合は、今回は友人と一緒に待って、後で並び直しても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黙って列を離れず、戻れない場合は友人と待って後で並び直してもよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not leave the line without saying anything. If I cannot return, I do not mind waiting with my friend this time and lining up again later.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not leave the line without telling anyone, and if you cannot return, you are happy to wait with your friend and line up again later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その選択もありますね。利用の受付が済んでいる場合は、取りやめる時の扱いも確認しましょう。券や受付の記録はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is another option. If you have already registered to ride, let us also check what happens if you decide not to use it. Do you have a ticket or registration record?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この券がありますが、まだ係員に渡していません。荷物を預ける条件が合わなければ、利用しない時の扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まだ係員に渡していない券を示し、荷物を預ける条件が合わず利用しない場合の扱いを知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have this ticket, but I have not handed it to the staff yet. If the luggage-storage conditions do not work for me, I want to ask what happens if I do not ride.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the ticket you have not handed to staff yet, and say you want to know what happens if unsuitable luggage conditions mean you choose not to ride. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券の種類と受付状況を見て、担当者が確認します。お渡しする前に、利用条件と荷物の置き方を納得できるまでお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the ticket type and registration status. Before handing it over, ask about the conditions of use and luggage placement until you are satisfied you understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 券を持ったまま担当者に確認します。荷物の扱いと列を離れる条件を聞いてから、乗るか友人と待つか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券を持って担当者に荷物と列を離れる条件を確認し、その後で乗るか友人と待つか決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep my ticket and check with the person in charge. After asking about luggage handling and conditions for leaving the line, I will decide whether to ride or wait with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep your ticket and ask staff about luggage and conditions for leaving the line, then decide whether to ride or wait with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの係員へご相談ください。周りの方の通行にも気をつけて、お待ちいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-OTARU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult this staff member. Thank you for waiting and for taking care not to obstruct people passing by.
